sections.content:
Capital Bank is delighted to collaborate with Royal Jordanian Airlines to launch the FIRST Cobranded Debit Card of its kind in Jordan and the Levant. Benefits:
• Fast Track Service in some countries.
• Airport Lounge Access : Access to 1300+ airport lounges in more than 500 cities around the world for up to 12 free annual visits for the cardholder by downloading VISA AIRPORT COMPANION subject to meeting a minimum spend of 1 USD as an international transaction either a POS machine or eCommerce transaction annually.
• Travel insurance Cardholder can issue their travel insurance policy through card our website, through enter Visa Card Benefits link
• Buyers Protection: Using your Visa Platinum card or payment device to pay for an Eligible Item, you will receive complimentary Buyers Protection Insurance.
• Visa Premium Concierge: As a Visa Signature cardholder, now you can have access to a digital concierge channel in addition to telephone and email service .
• Fraudulent Card Misuse Protection: All Visa Signature cards will be protected against unauthorized transactions or fraudulent use of their card by unrelated third parties. This insurance benefit will provide reimbursement of up to USD 2,500 per occurrence with a USD 4,000 annual aggregate limit for Visa Signature Cardholders.
